newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re's IRMG joins with GECALUX.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re's IRMG joins with GECALUX.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co. said its International Risk Management Group (IRMG) subsidiary had signed a letter of understanding with GECALUX SA, the leading captive manager in Luxembourg, to join forces in the field of risk advisory, captive management and risk engineering services.
Swiss Re said in a statement that the combined network of IRMG and GECALUX would rank as the largest independent provider of such services.
A Swiss Re spokesman said IRMG was especially strong in the U.S. and the cooperation with GECALUX was aimed at increasing its presence in Europe.
IRMG and GECALUX will focus on selling Alternative Risk Management (ART) services to Fortune 500 companies that have their own insurance services, the spokesman added.
